title: Ground Beef Fajitas
reject_reason: Fajita-seasoned ground beef with peppers/onions in tortillas is the taco-skillet Tex-Mex beef flavour in a wrap; duplicates live loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls (protein + Tex-Mex spice + skillet), consistent with the estate's repeated folding of ground-beef Tex-Mex skillets, and deepens rather than widens an American/Tex-Mex-heavy catalog.
